in_marathi.name: Kshanansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Divine moment, instant
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kshanansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Kshanansh is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kshana', meaning 'moment' or 'instant'. In Hindu mythology, the god of time is called 'Kala' and the term 'Kshana' refers to a single moment in time. The name signifies the divine moment, the present, and the importance of cherishing every second of life.
